·        Аналізує показники роботи сервісу Voice over LTE, готує рекомендації щодо вдосконалення параметрів радіомережі, транспортної мережі та основної мережі.

Глибокі знання у сфері телекомунікацій та новітніх радіотехнологій: досвід планування, побудови телекомунікаційних стільникових мереж мобільного зв’язку, оптимізації радіомережі, проведення поглибленого траблшутінгу та підвищення її ефективності.

·        Досвід роботи системами OSS (U2020, PRS, NetNumen, Nastar, Netmax).
·        Досвід проектування та оптимізації мереж LTE / VoLTE.
·        Знання KPI мережі LTE та основних параметрів. Знання сценаріїв SQL або сценаріїв VB. Знання Excel, Power BI, включаючи створення макросів VB.

• Allocate budget across channels, markets and audiences based on lead quality and commercial outcomes.

• Turn seller insights into offers, creative briefs and landing-page tests together with our creative and development partners.

• Connect campaign data to CRM and downstream outcomes (qualified leads, accepted and published leads, sales, refunds, realized revenue) and keep improving attribution.

• Build a clear testing and reporting rhythm, and drive solutions independently.

What we’re looking for

• Proven hands-on ownership of both Google and Meta, including multi-channel budget decisions - not agency oversight.

• Successful US lead-generation experience. Motivated-seller and homeowner lead generation is especially relevant; home services, mortgage, insurance or lead marketplaces are also welcome.

• Evidence of improving lead quality and business economics beyond platform CPL and ROAS.

• Experience improving creative, landing pages and conversion flows with designers and developers, validated through tracking and CRM data.

• Fast learning and independent execution, comfortable with AI and automation, and aware of platform policy and privacy constraints.

• Clear professional English and genuine end-to-end ownership.

TikTok experience is a strong advantage.
How success is measured
More qualified, commercially valuable seller leads at a sustainable acquisition cost, with positive contribution after acquisition costs and downstream quality and refund effects. We look at the combined result across channels, not a single platform metric.
Your first 30 days

• Establish a performance baseline and agree targets.

• Prioritize and ship campaign, creative and funnel improvements.

• Show which channel and market combinations deserve investment, with an evidence-backed scaling plan.

How to start the conversation
This is a hands-on lead role, not a strategy-only position. Please send your CV or LinkedIn profile plus 1-2 relevant cases: your personal role, the channels, spend and timeframe, the lead-quality and commercial results, and one decision that improved the outcome (anonymized cases are welcome). Also share your availability and compensation expectations.

Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

Vinted Go's acquisition team relies on a network of outsourced (BPO) partners across multiple countries to drive growth at scale. As we've expanded, managing this network across agencies, geographies, and performance targets has become a critical element for growth success. We're hiring a BPO Manager to own this network end-to-end - turning a sprawling, hard-to-manage set of vendor relationships into a well-governed, high-performing extension of the acquisition team.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who can operate simultaneously as a vendor manager, a performance analyst, a budget owner and most importantly a guarantor of the Vinted Go sales philosophy outside of the internal organization - building on top of the structure that currently exists. 

In this position, you’ll 

Vendor & Relationship Management

• Own the end-to-end relationship with all BPO/agency partners across countries: onboarding, day-to-day management, escalations, and offboarding

• Act as the single point of accountability for BPO performance, replacing the current fragmented oversight

• Negotiate and manage contracts, SLAs, and commercial terms with agencies

• Evaluate, select, and onboard new BPO partners as we scale into new markets

• Build a standardized operating framework (reporting cadence, WBRs, MBRs, escalation paths) that works consistently across agencies and countries

Performance Management

• Define and track KPIs/SLAs per agency and per market (quality, productivity, conversion, adherence, etc.)

• Build and maintain dashboards/reporting to give real-time visibility into performance across the whole network

• Identify underperforming partners or markets and drive corrective action plans

• Partner with acquisition leadership to translate business targets into agency-level performance expectations

• Run calibration and quality assurance processes to ensure consistency across agencies and geographies

Budget Management

• Own the BPO budget across all agencies and countries: forecasting, tracking spend, and reporting variance

• Analyze cost-per-outcome (cost per lead/acquisition/hour) across partners and markets to drive efficiency

• Identify and execute cost-optimization opportunities without compromising quality

• Provide regular budget and performance reporting to finance and leadership

Scale & Process
